_note: Voice callouts and the announcer (src/game/announcer.ts, docs/AAA_GAP.md step 7). Spoken by the browser's own speech synthesis, because free recorded voice lines are scarce and a set voice reading short lines is what an announcer is. Each line has who says it (`self` is your character, the way an Apex legend says 'enemy knocked'; `announcer` is the match's voice, Warzone's), a priority (a higher one goes ahead of a lower one waiting, and cuts one of lower priority off mid-word), its own cooldown in seconds (a spray of knocks is one 'enemy knocked', not four), and the words: one is picked at random each time so it does not repeat word for word. gap is the least time between the end of one line and the start of the next (a line is taken to last lead seconds plus perWord a word, at its voice's rate), stale how long a waiting line may wait before it is dropped (a line about a knock ten seconds ago is noise), queue how many may wait. Each voice has a rate, a pitch and the names of the system voices to prefer, first match wins, else the first English one. Ours.
